name: SASHI MENON
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A steady all-court player with a strong serve and tactical approach, effective on hard and grass courts.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #71 (October 6, 1975), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #128 (January 3, 1983).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Reached the second round of Wimbledon (1976, 1980, 1982) and the Australian Open (1974).
Notable Achievements: ATP Titles: Won 4 singles titles (e.g., 1978 Tinton Falls, 1979 South Fulton) and 3 doubles titles during his career from 1970 to 1984. Biggest Wins: Defeated Mark Edmondson (1979 Australian Open champ) in 1980 and Brian Gottfried (former World No. 3) in 1977. Davis Cup & National Representation: Represented India in Davis Cup ties from 1970 to 1984, with a notable win over Henri Leconte in 1984, finishing with a 16-15 record.
Other Highlights: Three-time All-American at USC. Played over 700 matches in his career. Transitioned to a successful career in investment banking, founding Menon/Brown Advisory Group in California.
Sashi retired in 1984, leaving a mark as one of India’s steady performers in the early Open Era. 🎾🇮🇳
